<main class="page blue">

<section class="hero">
<p class="kicker">Blue whales</p>
<button id="call" class="call call-tall" type="button" aria-label="Play the blue whale call" aria-pressed="false">
<picture><source srcset="assets/blue-call-dark.png" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)"><img class="call-base" src="assets/blue-call-light.png" alt=""></picture>
<picture><source srcset="assets/blue-call-dark.png" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)"><img id="call-top" class="call-top" src="assets/blue-call-light.png" alt="Spectrogram of a blue whale call: three curved harmonic lines."></picture>
</button>
<p class="call-hint" id="call-hint">Tap the call to hear it, sped up 10 times</p>
<audio id="audio" src="assets/blue-call.mp3" preload="auto" data-start="1.137" data-end="2.983"></audio>
<p class="lede">About 239,000 blue whales lived in the Antarctic before whaling. A survey in the late 1990s found about 2,280.</p>
<p class="scroll-hint" aria-hidden="true">&#8595;</p>
</section>

<section class="data-section" aria-label="Blue whale estimates, whaling and shipping by year">
<p id="year" class="year">2024</p>

```{=html}
<div class="stats">
<p class="stat s1"><span id="v0" class="num"></span><span class="lab" id="v0y">Antarctic estimate</span></p>
<p class="stat s2"><span id="v1" class="num"></span><span class="lab">blue whales caught</span></p>
<p class="stat s3"><span id="v2" class="num"></span><span class="lab">million tons shipped by sea</span></p>
</div>
<svg id="plot" class="plot" viewBox="0 0 600 300" role="img" aria-label="Blue whales caught each year from 1900, seaborne trade from 1970, and Antarctic blue whale estimates with ranges."></svg>
<div class="slider-row">
<button id="sweep" class="sweep" type="button" aria-label="Play timeline">&#9654;</button>
<input id="slider" class="slider" type="range" min="1900" max="2024" step="1" value="2024" aria-label="Year">
</div>
```

<p class="note">Each series is drawn against its own highest value. Whale estimates are dots with 95% ranges, and the hollow dot uses a different method, so the dots don't form a trend. Shipping dots mark years with data. Worldwide, about 5,000 to 15,000 mature blue whales remain today.</p>
<noscript><p>The full table is in data/blue-whale-series.csv.</p></noscript>
</section>

<section class="closing">
<p>You are wearing this call.</p>
</section>

```{=html}
<section class="ears" data-animal="blue-whale" aria-labelledby="ears-title">
<h2 id="ears-title"><span class="ears-word">EARS</span> for blue whales</h2>
<p class="ears-lede">All of our proceeds go to supporting wildlife. Have your own say below in where the money goes.</p>
<form class="ears-code" novalidate>
<label for="ears-key">Code from your shirt tag</label>
<input id="ears-key" name="code" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="characters" spellcheck="false" placeholder="XXXX-XXXX" maxlength="9">
</form>
<div class="ears-grid" role="group" aria-label="Choose where the money goes">
<button type="button" class="ears-opt" data-choice="E" disabled><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M24 13c-5-3-11-4-17-3v26c6-1 12 0 17 3 5-3 11-4 17-3V10c-6-1-12 0-17 3z"/><path d="M24 13v26"/></svg><span class="ears-name"><b>E</b>ducation</span><span class="ears-desc">Teaching and outreach</span><span class="ears-pct" data-k="E"></span></button>
<button type="button" class="ears-opt" data-choice="A" disabled><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M24 6l15 6v11c0 9-6 16-15 19C15 39 9 32 9 23V12z"/><path d="M24 33c-4-3-5-8-1-13 3 3 6 6 1 13zM24 33v-9"/></svg><span class="ears-name"><b>A</b>ction</span><span class="ears-desc">Protecting habitat and reducing threats</span><span class="ears-pct" data-k="A"></span></button>
<button type="button" class="ears-opt" data-choice="R" disabled><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 24h4l3-8 4 16 4-12 3 8 3-4h3"/><circle cx="33" cy="22" r="8"/><path d="M39 28l5 5"/></svg><span class="ears-name"><b>R</b>esearch</span><span class="ears-desc">Monitoring and science</span><span class="ears-pct" data-k="R"></span></button>
<button type="button" class="ears-opt" data-choice="S" disabled><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M24 30V18"/><path d="M24 20c-1-5-5-8-10-8 0 5 4 9 10 8zM24 23c1-5 5-8 10-8 0 5-4 9-10 8z"/><path d="M6 33c4 0 6 3 10 3h8c2 0 2-3 0-3h-6M42 33c-4 0-6 3-10 3"/><path d="M6 40c6 0 9 2 18 2s12-2 18-2"/></svg><span class="ears-name"><b>S</b>tewardship</span><span class="ears-desc">Community-led conservation</span><span class="ears-pct" data-k="S"></span></button>
```

<footer>
<p><strong>Data.</strong> Catches: blue and pygmy blue whales, 1900 to 2024, Rocha et al. (2014) and the International Whaling Commission, via <a href="https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/whale-catch">Our World in Data</a>. Before 1985 excludes illegal Soviet catches. Shipping: total goods loaded, <a href="https://unctad.org/system/files/official-document/rmt2021_en_0.pdf">UNCTAD Review of Maritime Transport</a> (2021, 2024 and 2025 editions). Antarctic estimates: circumpolar surveys centered on 1981, 1988 and 1998, <a href="https://journal.iwc.int/index.php/jcrm/article/view/674">Branch et al. (2004)</a>, with ranges calculated from their CVs; 2019 capture-recapture estimate and the pre-whaling figure from <a href="https://repository.library.noaa.gov/view/noaa/66803/noaa_66803_DS1.pdf">Olson et al. (2025)</a>. Global figure: IUCN Red List (Cooke 2018). <a href="data/blue-whale-series.csv">Download the table</a>. The call is synthesized from a published spectrogram, not a recording.</p>
</footer>

</main>
